qwen3.voiceDescription: Mature male documentary narrator, around 65 years old, from Spain (Castilian accent). Extremely deep and rich baritone-bass voice, velvety and warm, gentle and affectionate tone, mysterious but comforting. Measured pace, crisp pronunciation, very clear and easy to understand.
